description: Office of the Public Service Commission - Amendment to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Agriculture Service
reasoning: This gazette notification contains amendments to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Agriculture Service, which relates to public service recruitment criteria, qualifications, and service conditions. It is issued by the Public Service Commission and deals with administrative matters concerning public sector employment, specifically addressing recruitment ratios and service requirements for agricultural service positions. This falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) as it concerns public sector service administration rather than government structure/personnel changes.
